Screen-right: his father Junho, a handsome Korean man about 33, youthful adult features, neatly styled short black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a plain muted navy shirt with sleeves rolled to his forearms, charcoal trousers and simple unbranded shoes. Natural adult-toddler height difference. Relaxed separate standing poses close enough for a safe family portrait, both faces and complete bodies visible; calm gentle expressions, no exaggerated grin. Original faces, no requested celebrity or real-person likeness. Natural skin texture and believable anatomy. Plain warm-gray seamless background, broad soft OFF-CAMERA daylight and gentle fill, grounded soft contact shadows beneath the feet. No lighting equipment visible, no softbox, bench, coat, rain, glow, extra people, physical embrace, writing, labels, logos or panels. This establishes faces, relative age, scale and wardrobe only; later scenes will be separately staged and lit.
